title: Probabilistic canary tethers with contextual score filters for per-customer reference sets
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Create a new rollout gating mechanism that ties per-customer reference prompt sets ("anchor prompts") to probabilistic canary decisions. Instead of a single hard threshold on an aggregate scorecard, the system will compute contextual filters (prompt-type / intent buckets / customer-specific tolerances) and produce a weighted pass probability. This ticket covers design and implementation of: 1) an enrichment pipeline that tags incoming golden prompts with metadata (intent, length, business impact tier), 2) a scoring engine that computes contextual z-scores and a weighted aggregation across multiple metrics (accuracy, hallucination rate, token-level divergence), and 3) a "tether" layer that maps pass probability to canary weight, enabling gradual exposure with automatic rollback/hysteresis when probability falls below policy. The feature must integrate with the Console (per-route gating UI), rollout conductor (canary -> ramp policies), alerting (PagerDuty/webhook), and the eval harness for simulation runs against historical traffic. Key goals: reduce false-positive rollbacks for noisy prompts, allow per-customer sensitivity tuning, and provide deterministic reproduce paths for incidents.
comments: 2025-01-28 - Aisha: Kickoff. Drafted design with product. Primary restraint is eval compute cost when running high-fidelity scoring for large customers. Proposed sampling + stratified replay to keep cost in check.

2025-01-30 - Marco: Engineering notes - plan to implement scoring engine as a sidecar service (scoring-api) that consumes cached KV outputs to avoid re-running model inference for golden prompts during canary checks.

2025-02-03 - PM (Lina Perez): User story - customers should be able to upload 3 sensitivity profiles (conservative/standard/lenient) and attach to a dedicated rollout. UI mockups linked in Confluence.
2025-02-05 - Design review (Rajat Singh): Feedback - add per-prompt stabilization window and hysteresis counters to reduce churn; prefer percentile-based aggregation over mean to handle outliers.
2025-02-07 - Security (Maya): Flag - storing customer anchor prompts needs retention policy and access controls. Added requirement to encrypt at rest and audit access. Security review initiated.

2025-02-09 - Marco: Implementation update - basic scoring-api prototype finished. End-to-end test against canned replay passed for 10k prompts; profiling shows ~18% CPU and 12% mem increase on canary nodes. Link to perf dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood/eng/score-profiles
2025-02-10 - QA (Jordan): Test plan added. Will run staged shadow tests (10%, 25%, 50%) with synthetic anomalies to validate false-positive rate target <= 2% for standard profile.

2025-02-11 - Aisha: Decision log - adopt weighted median aggregation with contextual buckets, default sensitivity 'standard'. Add feature flag to fallback to legacy gate for 30 days after rollout. Next: finalize runbook and run a controlled production simulation week.
